idea-plugin.name: HDF5 Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Viewer for HDF5 files (.h5, .hdf5, .hdf, .he5).

  • Browse the nested group/dataset hierarchy as a tree.
  • Inspect attributes on any group or dataset.
  • View dataset contents in a table/array viewer, including slicing of N-dimensional arrays and column display of compound types.

Reading is powered by the pure-Java jHDF library, so no native libraries are required. Files are opened read-only.
